summary: Connect IFRS 9 ECL, Basel credit risk and reporting controls through applied portfolio cases. Explore the course and its practical outputs.
lede: Credit risk implementation connects loan-level data with expected credit loss measurement, capital treatment and reporting controls. For credit risk, portfolio, reporting and audit professionals, it builds practical skills in checking data quality and staging, reviewing PD, LGD and EAD assumptions, and reconciling ECL outputs with capital measures. Exercises include sample calculations, model review and reporting checklists.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who handle loan portfolio measurement, model oversight, prudential reporting or independent review across banks and other credit providers.
prerequisites: Working knowledge of lending, credit risk, accounting or prudential reporting is recommended. No coding is required; exercises use loan portfolio case data and Excel calculations. Familiarity with IFRS 9 or credit portfolio reporting will help you apply the examples.
